title: LOOSE FLOOR DEBRIS
why: His pick 79: papers, small boxes and bolts scatter from sprinting bodies, nearby shots and blasts and stay for the raid. Watch: sprint past a loot site, fire beside its litter, then blast it; scraps should slide outward and stay put without blocking movement or making noise.
now: Light floor clutter reacts to movement and combat. LOCAL: no linked review. Each window animates its own cosmetic scraps from existing body and effect copies; no packets or shared gameplay fields change.
